title: Closing Delay Per Diem Charge on the Home Purchase Agreement — Desk Tool Card
content:
**Policy.** A closing delay per diem is owed on a Home Purchase Agreement when the buyer has not closed on the scheduled closing date of an agreement in status closing scheduled for a reason on the buyer's side, and it is booked as one charge covering one delay period. The charge is a closing delay per diem charge that records the delay period's first day and last day.

**Situation of use and capability.** The tool `assess_closing_delay_per_diem_8d15ee11` books one closing delay per diem charge on a Home Purchase Agreement for one period of buyer delay. One call adds a single charge line of type closing delay per diem to the agreement's buyer statement, recording the delay period's start date and end date and the amount charged, dated today, under a newly printed charge number. The agreement's fees-and-per-diem balance owed by the buyer rises by the same amount, and the buyer sees the new charge line, with its charge number and period, on the statement.

**How it is invoked.** `assess_closing_delay_per_diem_8d15ee11` is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `purchase_id` | The reference number identifying the Home Purchase Agreement being charged, as returned by the purchase agreement lookup for this buyer | Identifier |
| `period_start` | The calendar date the charged delay period starts on | YYYY-MM-DD, local calendar date, no time part |
| `period_end` | The calendar date the charged delay period ends on | YYYY-MM-DD, local calendar date, no time part |
| `amount` | The per diem charged for the period, in USD | Positive number rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a dictionary rendered as text with: `status` ("booked" when the charge line was written), `purchase_event_id` (reference number of the new charge line), `charge_reference` (the charge number printed on the buyer statement, CHG-HP- followed by four digits), `purchase_id`, `period_start` and `period_end` (YYYY-MM-DD), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `buyer_charges_due` (USD, 2 decimal places: the fees and per diem the buyer now owes on the agreement). Where no Home Purchase Agreement carries the given reference number, the tool returns an error stating that there is no such Home Purchase Agreement, and nothing is booked.

**Illustration of a call (hypothetical values).** A call with `purchase_id` set to a placeholder agreement reference, `period_start` 2026-03-11, `period_end` 2026-03-20 and `amount` 1800.00 writes one charge line for that period; the receipt shows status "booked", a new CHG-HP- charge number, the same period dates, the amount 1800.00 and the buyer's new fees-and-per-diem balance.

**Contract questions.**

*Does one call cover several delay periods?* No. One call books a single charge line for one period.

*What date is the charge dated?* The day it is booked (today).
